run_xnli_training_evaluation: run the XNLI class to train and evaluate a cross-lingual NLI model on 15 languages
load_xnli_cross_lingual_data: load XNLI cross-lingual classification data for training, validation, and test splits
train_xnli_model: train the XNLI model by finetuning the embedder and projection layer on English data
eval_xnli_accuracy: evaluate the XNLI model accuracy on validation and test sets across all supported languages
get_xnli_data_iterator: get a monolingual data iterator for a specific split and language in the XNLI dataset
